name: Holidays
description: News about public holidays in the United States: new federal holidays, observed-date rules when a holiday falls on a weekend, state holidays that differ from the federal list, and federal office closures announced by the Office of Personnel Management. Each story states the exact date, the day of the week and whether federal offices, banks, schools and the postal service are open. Where a holiday date changes, the story links to the matching when-is page and the printable monthly calendar so readers can update the calendar on the wall the same day.
